description: First fifty paired epidemic/protection draws from 5000 pre-pandemic simulations of 2011/12–2018/19; pre-pandemic VE estimates only.
calendar_alignment: Each protection curve is shifted to its own scenario-optimal vaccination week. The matching red dot marks the dose date, before the saved immune-response delay.
epidemic_alignment: State 4 chooses shifts by maximum shared area of AUC-normalized epidemic curves, then displays each curve divided by its September baseline. Optimal-date dots move with their curves. The threshold uses all 5000 training pairs; the displayed alignment uses 50.
regret_definition: Remaining burden at a candidate date minus the minimum remaining burden in that same scenario.
threshold_evaluation: State 5 applies the frozen pre-pandemic activity threshold and mean-utility-optimal fixed week to 5000 posterior epidemic/protection pairs from 2023/24–2025/26. Retrospective simulation with revised latent curves; not a real-time evaluation. The first 50 pairs are displayed; metrics use all 5000.
